digest.component_or_area: Reconciler comment synchronization (binding_store, outbound comment diff)
propositions: Comment identity currently relies on normalized body text equality, causing collisions when same-text comments exist; must migrate to persistent HLC timestamp → Jira comment ID map
Returned Jira comment IDs from add_comment API calls are discarded at both enactment sites (create_one and update_one); must capture and persist these IDs against the local comment key

Comment bodies are not rendered through RichTextCodec during diff/sync, leaving the dedup key misaligned with the actual wire format sent to Jira; must render through real codec (AdfCodec for Cloud, WikiTextCodec for DC) with fit-then-serialize ordering
Outbound and inbound comment identity mechanisms must not compete; inbound-origin comments use jira_comment_id while outbound use the persistent map, each authoritative for its direction

Sync semantics are append-only (mirror creation, never edit/delete), but current body-equality logic can re-sync edited comments; identity must become primary guard with body-equality demoted to secondary fallback
ADF encode on Cloud must fit text first before JSON serialization to avoid truncating mid-structure and exceeding ACLI payload limits
